description: Use for positions of two to five wallets in one batch call, for example after a ranking. Covers one venue with bounded upstream concurrency and reports individual wallet failures. Accepts an optional asset for named markets.

addresses.description: Two to five distinct wallet addresses

asset.description: Market name, like Nvidia, BTC or NVDA

dex.description: Venue prefix; empty for the main perp venue

name: get_hyperliquid_wallets_positions
title: Inspect multiple wallets
